# interval coincides with

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:intervalCoincidesWith`](gmeow-intervalCoincidesWith.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/intervalCoincidesWith>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/temporal`](../../slices/temporal.md)
- **Box roles:** [RBox role](../boxes/rbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

Allen EQUALS: this interval and the related interval share the same temporal extent. Symmetric and transitive. TEMPORAL simultaneity only, never identity of the intervals themselves. (= [time:intervalEquals](http://www.w3.org/2006/time#intervalEquals))

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use when two distinct intervals share exactly the same start and end — co-extensive spans such as a fiscal year and an audit window that are temporally simultaneous but ontologically different things.

### Avoid when

- Avoid reading it as identity of the intervals — it asserts temporal simultaneity only, never [owl:sameAs](http://www.w3.org/2002/07/owl#sameAs) ([Principle 5](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/CONSTITUTION.md#principle-5)); two coinciding intervals remain distinct individuals.

### How to use

- Assert between the two co-extensive [`gmeow:TimeInterval`](../classes/gmeow-TimeInterval.md) individuals; symmetric and transitive, so the reverse and any chained equalities follow (= [time:intervalEquals](http://www.w3.org/2006/time#intervalEquals)).

### Examples

- ex:fiscalYear2024 [`gmeow:intervalCoincidesWith`](gmeow-intervalCoincidesWith.md) ex:auditPeriod.
